name: atlas-auth/atlas-pca
description: Official PHP SDK for Atlas Proof-Carrying Authority (PCActn): the verifier (strict-JSON wire format v2, Ed25519/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA signatures, capability-chain and plan-inclusion checks, optional PSR-15 / Laravel middleware) and the agent side (grants, delegation, signed actions).

suggest.ext-openssl: Needed by the hardware attestation verifiers (Atlas\Pca\Attest), offline Sigstore bundle verification (Atlas\Pca\SigstoreBundle) and the ML-DSA FFI path.
suggest.ext-ffi: Needed by Atlas\Pca\ActionsYamlLoad (the YAML authoring loader, over libyaml), Atlas\Pca\FndsaNative (real FN-DSA over libfndsa) and Atlas\Pca\FheSeal (the homomorphic risk gate over Microsoft SEAL's C export API, libsealc) and the FFI paths of the pairing packages.
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: To use the framework-agnostic PSR-15 middleware (Atlas\Pca\PcaMiddleware) in Slim, Mezzio, Laminas, etc.
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required by PcaMiddleware to build its error responses (any PSR-17 factory).
suggest.guzzlehttp/psr7: A PSR-7/PSR-17 implementation PcaMiddleware can auto-discover for its error responses; nyholm/psr7 also works.
suggest.symfony/psr-http-message-bridge: For the Laravel route middleware (Atlas\Pca\Laravel\PcaGuard, PcaServiceProvider) and the Symfony request subscriber (Atlas\Pca\Symfony\PcaRequestSubscriber), which run PcaMiddleware on HttpFoundation requests.
suggest.theodo-group/llphant: Atlas\Pca\LlPhant\PcaToolProxy wraps the object a LLPhant FunctionInfo points at, so every tool call the model makes is signed as a proof-carrying action first.
suggest.openai-php/client: Atlas\Pca\OpenAi\ToolDispatch signs a PCActn for each chat-completion tool call and runs the mapped handler with the proof.
